exam-planner.title: Exam planner — UniSkilled
exam-planner.add-an-exam-and: Add an exam and the topics it covers. You get a day-by-day revision plan up to the exam date, and you can change it any time.
exam-planner.topics-one-per-line: Topics, one per line, in the order you want to learn them
exam-planner.up-to-30-topics: Up to 30 topics. Your lecture slides or the syllabus are a good place to find them.
exam-planner.the-plan-is-a: The plan is a suggestion to help you spread your revision. It doesn't predict your result. Your exams and plans are private to you.
exam-planner.js.e-30: Use 30 topics or fewer. Group small ones together.
exam-planner.js.e-days: Pick at least one day of the week to study.
exam-planner.js.e-past: The exam date needs to be after today.
exam-planner.js.e-year: Choose an exam date within the next year.
exam-planner.js.e-no-days: There are no study days left before the exam on the days you picked. Add more days.
exam-planner.js.save-failed: Your plan couldn’t be saved. Please try again.
exam-planner.js.no-more: No more study days in this plan.
exam-planner.js.tutor-help: A tutor who passed this course can go through it with you.
exam-planner.js.load-failed: Could not load your exams. Please refresh the page.
exam-planner.js.from-bookings-1: From your bookings: you mentioned this exam to a tutor.
exam-planner.js.from-bookings: From your bookings: you mentioned these exams to a tutor.
exam-planner.js.confirm-delete: Delete “{{title}}” and its plan? This can’t be undone.
